name: Sidedness Test
definition: A pruning test ensuring that for a valid refraction point, the light L lies on the positive side of the shading normal and the viewer V lies on the negative side within the critical angle cone.
summary: The Sidedness Test is a geometric pruning test that determines if a position bounding box and normal bounding cone can satisfy refraction conditions, differing from the smooth normal test by using a 3D box instead of a 2D triangle.
